notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678577/4580b81ffb8fd1abc877ee429906eee502e522cd.png

Hello everyone. Update 1.6 is now live on the main branch. This update should hopefully address some issues that people have been having in the game. 

Minor Mechanical Changes

Tier 3 farms are significantly less likely to desertify.

Bugfixes
⚙️Two significant memory leaks were addressed
⚙️Edge-case crash when closing space program window fixed
⚙️Edge-case crash when sharing intelligence fixed
⚙️Units pathfinding over bridges repaired
⚙️Faith sites no longer spawn in mountains
⚙️Oryx no longer spawn in mountains, nor do they enter them
⚙️Loan confirmation windows now show the correct numbers if you possess a bank
⚙️The space program risk mitigation checks no longer have rounding errors
⚙️Sharing intelligence now works as intended for cordial relationship levels, feedback updated accordingly
⚙️Player-trained units no longer spawn in towns
⚙️Tile rendering bug addressed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678577/5d709f98ebcae7d9baca2d5c50118dff42ba1450.png

Thank you as always for supporting this game, leaving your feedback and reviews, and being part of the Rogue State community! Let us know your thoughts on this update in the comments or over at the Discord.

notes.title: Rogue State Revolution Update 1.5 is now live on the main branch.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678577/8931e0bd2b218b57758c41d0f298953d7822a8dc.png


Update 1.5 
Update your game to check out the following features and fixes in action.

New Mechanics
Plutocrats and Communists are new political alignments added to the game. 
🗣️ Both are considered minorities in the political spectrum of your population. As wealthy capitalists who will strongly reject any policies that interfere with the profitability of their business, plutocrats are conservatives with more extreme views and will insist upon consistent economic growth. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678577/fdae62991158aaeda2cc4012633578133d4c8136.png

Communists are liberals who will feel even more strongly about workers' rights and state ownership over the industry. They will insist upon the redistribution of wealth throughout Basenji.

Map seeds! 
🗺️ Now you can record and replay your favorite maps.  Altering the game settings will make minor adjustments to the final map, but the neighboring nations will be consistent.

https://i.ibb.co/Pg78vph/RSR-1-5-map-seeds.gif


Bugfixes
⚙️ The game speed cannot be accelerated when zeppelins, mechs, or palaces are destroyed.
⚙️ Journalist Tier 3 tooltip now shows the correct explanation of their effect.
⚙️ Clandestine sites can always be recaptured during the machine war scenario.


Thank you as always for supporting this game, leaving your feedback and reviews, and being part of the Rogue State community! Let us know your thoughts on this update in the comments or over at the Discord.

notes.title: Update 1.4a is live on main with some interesting updates.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35678577/7d9b810189bf238a2bccb8272b7c2549628f9f06.png

Fresh of the presses in Basenji we have news of some recent updates to Rogue State Revolution. 
These include but are not limited to, allowing all sentient life forms the ability to plow and pillage cities. Isn't that nice for them...

Update 1.4
Major Mechanical Changes
🐔 All non-animal, non-mech, units can now move through and attack in cities.

Minor Mechanical Changes
🐐 Helicopters will no longer "park" over mountains when capturing a building.
🐐 Terrain generation updated and rebalanced.
🐐 Public gardens are getting nerfed.
🐐 Casino effects made more powerful.
🐐 Free policies and cash in future playthroughs now a selectable option.

Bugfixes
⚙️ Pandemic crisis restored for all players (when the setting is toggled).
⚙️ Production particle bugfix.
⚙️ Neighbour flags will now show in war notifications.
⚙️ Fixed unit placement when loading savegames.
⚙️ Repaired texture in the office.
⚙️ Updated codebase for road rendering, lifted some bridge construction restrictions.
⚙️ Fixed lagspike when deleting roads.

Thank you as always for supporting this game, leaving your feedback and reviews, and being part of the Rogue State community!

notes.title: The Urban Renewal Update is live on main branch now!
notes.notes:
https://i.ibb.co/MfPcKQj/RSR-Steam-News-800x450-1-3-MAIN.png

Update 1.3 now available on the main branch of the game. 

A reminder of everything contained in this update:

New Features

🐓 Corruption reworked. A nationwide corruption rate is now solely a product of implemented policies, particularly in the Ministries of Finance, Justice, and Foreign Affairs. This rate can be positive or negative, so players can even commit to campaigns of decorruption at the policy level. Corruption does result in reduced output from resource producers, but players no longer need to address this with a facilities inspector. Now, all resource producing buildings have a SPECIAL INSPECTION action which eliminates all corruption at that building at a cost of $20 and 5 Intelligence.

https://i.ibb.co/Wtr05zH/RSR-New-Corruption-Mechanics.gif

🐓 The Facilities Inspector is now a Journalist. Journalists are optional units that travel from city to city and trigger instant events which are generally positive for the player, in many cases, they yield Minister loyalty and favors. Each city can only be visited once, and cities are marked after they have had a Journalist visit. This also means around 15 new events have been added to the game. Journalists become very expensive in games at higher difficulty levels.

https://i.ibb.co/t390592/RSR-New-Journalism-Mechanics.gif

🐓 Building capture mechanics reimagined. Units no longer are consumed when capturing a building.  Buildings are now captured when a unit is positioned adjacent to it and are recaptured when there are no adjacent units. The AI has been reworked to "take and hold" buildings of perceived strategic importance.

https://i.ibb.co/xfxCTCF/RSR-New-building-mechanics.gif

🐓 Land fertility added. Not all fertile terrain is treated equally, and farms will produce more food on terrain with high fertility and less on more arid land. Tile greenness will signal land fertility, and detailed numbers are visible in the lower right detail bar.

https://i.ibb.co/pR8nFLn/RSR-Updated-Land-Fertility-Mechanics.gif

🐓 Tier Two Nature Preserves (Zoos) and Tier Two Markets (Souks). Nature Preserves can be converted into Zoos, which reduce their environmental impact but dramatically improve regional entertainment.  Tier Two Markets become Souks and further improve prosperity as well as increasing entertainment and tourist attractiveness.

https://i.ibb.co/k6bLphN/RSR-Nature-Preserves-Zoos.gif

🐓 Two new policies: "Tax Faith Organizations" in the Ministry of Finance and "Open Reservoirs" in the Ministry of Natural Resources.

https://i.ibb.co/LPLVWzF/RSR-Tier-Two-Markets-Souks.gif

🎵 A new music track! 

Minor Mechanical Changes

🌍 UNESCO sites produce a small amount of education.
🌍 Tier one nature preserve effects reduced.
🌍 All ground-based units except for mechs can move through tunnels.  Units inside a tunnel can't attack and can't be attacked. So you can "hide" your units in tunnels.  The AI takes that into account and won't target units that are currently inside tunnels.
🌍 Qarifii stay-decision threshold reduced to 58%.
🌍 Tier 3 drones have increased loyalty.

Quality of Life Features

🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 All reds in the UI made far less severe in vibrancy.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 A new UI element in the Demographics menu will show how the people perceive your current political alignment.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Tax policy tooltips show the exact predicted tax income next month.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Minor redesign of spaceport UI to better communicate mission options and status.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Hotkeys can now be configured for all your most important actions, including upgrading roads.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 A warning comes up before you launch those WMDs.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Right-click map dragging is now an optional setting that defaults to off.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Construct walls tooltip explains how walls work and reminds players that they don't need them on mountains.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Players are now notified when rebels destroy a building.
🧑🏼‍🤝‍🧑🏼 Players reminded about the retirement option at month eight and when the budget gets particularly bad.

Bugfixes

⚙️ Crashfix.  Rare crash during map generation.
⚙️ Crashfix.  Loading a saved game no longer crashes when the mouse hits a faith tile.
⚙️ The tutorial text can no longer be affected by the game settings.
⚙️ Edict discovery visual glitch addressed.
⚙️ Neighbour-themed events don't occur when you're at war with that neighbour.
⚙️ Total restructuring of the nuclear enrichment code.
⚙️ Cleric edict affecting aridness has been scaled back.

https://i.ibb.co/QYDPs2g/SUEZ-TAKE-CHARGE-TODAY-confettiw.gif

There we have it! We hope you're enjoying the game so far and that these updates add even more quality to your experience as the President of Basenji. To access the beta branch, right-click on Rogue State Revolution in your Steam library, select "Properties", then "Betas", and choose Beta Test Branch from the drop-down menu. If all goes well, we expect to push this update to the default branch very soon.

As always you can join other players in discussing the game over at our Discord and we'd be very grateful if you could take the time to leave a review here on Steam.

Good luck out there Your Excellency!

notes.title: No joke: The super-packed Update 1.2 is live!
notes.notes:
https://i.ibb.co/yPKYVfM/RSR-Steam-News-18-800x450.png

Presidents of Basenji, this is not an April Fool's gag: Update 1.2 is live for Rogue State Revolution. Let's get straight into this chunky update.

New content
:cityscape: Imports from regional influencers. Click on the US, Russia and China buttons to see your status and pre-requesites to level up your relationship. It is now possible to receive unlimited imports if your relationship is solid enough.
:cityscape: Tier 3 facilities inspectors can now use "Master Accountant" on uncorrupted buildings.

Quality of Life Changes
:cityscape: Disabling sandstorm particle effects is now an option.
:cityscape: Economy feedback arrows calibrated to a more appropriate scale.

Game balance changes
:gear: Prospecting has a nine month timeout.
:gear: Yields of all resource producing builds increased considerably.
:gear: Good demands from city growth significantly reduced.
:gear: Worker cost of non-revenue generating buildings increased.
:gear: Human Factors Intel removed from the game. Don't worry, we'll replace it with something cool later.
:gear: Upgraded highways can now handle twice the traffic pressure.
:gear: Maneating tigers no longer destroy armored units, though we admit it was pretty fun to watch.
:gear: Maneating tigers can be killed by predator drones. And only predator drones.

Bugfixes
:gear: Crashfix: Embassy bilateral relationship edge case crash resolved.
:gear: Can no longer go into negative action points with trade renegotiations.
:gear: Camera shake settings are now saved.
:gear: Holy sites can no longer spawn over villages.
:gear: Playing on Challenging difficulty no longer unlocks the Brutal achievement, and vice versa.
:gear: Free trade agreements no longer prevent export requests from being fulfilled.
:gear: All edicts are now unlockable.
:gear: Strip-mining no longer requires the exploitation perspective.
:gear: Tooltip mismatch of clandestine server banks fixed.
:gear: Long distance photography now increases view distance as well as detection distance.
:gear: Tutorial no longer gets stuck when reviewing the national budget.
:gear: Upgrading border checkpoints no longer improves the international security rating of unrelated buildings.
:gear: Neighbouring country research now always allows research at 30 intelligence and no longer reappears when it shouldn't.
:gear: Cutscene menu was playing the wrong cutscene for "Twelve Years".
:gear: Embassy bilateral relationship action now works fully as intended.

We promised changes to building captures and other unit adjustments with 1.2, but because of the work that has to go into AI adjustments we've elected to bump those back to 1.3 in order for us to focus on getting 1.2 out sooner. Don't worry, more good stuff is coming!

Some of the new text may not yet be localized into languages other than English, but that'll be addressed as soon as possible.

A lot of work went into implementing and testing these, but it pales in comparison to the thoughtful feedback we've been getting from you all. Thank you for helping make Rogue State Revolution even better!

Stay tuned here on Steam, on Discord, and on the Modern Wolf Twitter for more details on the next updates soon.

notes.title: Update 1.1b HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Two updates in the same Sunday.  Introducing Hotfix 1.1b that should resolve two uncommon crashes that we've discovered.  We have collected your feedback and will be sharing a Trello shortly going over the state of the reported bugs, what we've been able to reproduce and what we're currently working on.

We're requesting a little more time to test the new commodity import mechanics from the US, Russia and China, but our hope is to get those live as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update 1.1a HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Letting you know that we've just pushed a hotfix (1.1a) for players unable to complete the final battle for the future of Basenji.  Apologies for the inconvenience surrounding this bug.  This patch should not interfere with save games.

A second update revealing the much-requested mechanic of additional trade with the US, Russia and China will be going live to the beta branch very soon!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is live now, containing new content and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
We got a whopper of an update that's just gone live on the main branch. Containing new content 🏙️ and bug fixes ⚙️. We're excited to see your feedback on this.

Let's get straight into what these patch notes include.

UPDATE 1.1
New content
🏙️When all resources have been surveyed, uncertain resources pins despawn and players can prospect for new deposits for $100.
🏙️Tier 3 surveyors now have a chance that new deposits prospected include resources not previously present in Basenji (including uranium!)
🏙️All cities now grow in population (and workers) over time.
🏙️Immigration demand for stable countries slightly nerfed in response to the potency of the above.
🏙️Resource producing building job demands slightly decreased.
🏙️Non-resource producing building job demands slightly increased.
🏙️Maximum trade balance for free trade agreements set.
🏙️Rebalancing of trade quantity thresholds.
🏙️Al-Hadi Minister effect nerfed to 1% every five months.
🏙️Green Economy far less desirable for conservatives.
🏙️Sustainability increases polluting building costs by 50%.
🏙️Green Economy increases polluting building costs by 100%.
🏙️Facilities inspector and intelligence officer move speed increased.
🏙️Removal of airport-specific Ministry of Transportation policies.
🏙️Two new Ministry of Transport policies: Permit Self-Driving Cars and Deregulate Taxis
🏙️Negotiate trade dialogue redesigned.
🏙️Trade agreements can always be adjusted upward at no penalty if relationships improve.
🏙️Trade agreements can always be adjusted downward for a 3% relationship penalty to a minimum of 10 goods/turn.
🏙️Minor adjustment to the tutorial to facilitate the above.
🏙️Camera rotation and panning can be sped up with the SHIFT key.
🏙️Setting added to disable movement range highlights.
🏙️Non-repeating space missions explicitly are described as such.
🏙️Selected ministers continue to share their provincial, political, and religious views.


Bugfixes
⚙️Crash bugfix: Tier 3 surveyor pathfinding calculations were stalling older CPUs.
⚙️Crash bugfix: Wrong call button was disabled when at war and Qarif independent.
⚙️Crash bugfix: The game was removing citizens without updating the tile population array.
⚙️Crashfix where the game was removing citizens without updating the tile population array.
⚙️Army base tutorial sequence glitch resolved.
⚙️Attractiveness from buildings was not updating immediately upon construction.
⚙️Museum wings are now specific to each museum.
⚙️Museum wing statuses are restored on the loaded game.
⚙️Chemical weapons now work, you monster.
⚙️Space program now shows accurate information on the space program, including on game load.
⚙️BLF HQ will no longer one-shot the Glorious Leader, badass as it may be.
⚙️Fixed an issue where the fog of war would not update properly after a unit is sent home from war.
⚙️Fixed an issue with movement range highlights when two calculations are called at the same time.
⚙️Qarif will no longer congratulate you on an election you didn't win.
⚙️Policy art will update when el-Kamali changes political direction.
⚙️Minister Morcos can now receive favor points.
⚙️Units will untarget a country after war has ended.
⚙️Wildlife will no longer leave Basenji's borders.
⚙️Wildlife will no longer attempt to use tunnels.
⚙️Extreme edge-cases for resource generation resolved.
⚙️Approval graphs accessed from the budget no longer have an orange tint.
⚙️The diplomacy UI will no longer be closed with ESC if you're in the middle of a dialogue.
⚙️Calling a neighbor is disabled when calling is not permitted.
⚙️Armistices can not be called when unit orders are being processed.
⚙️UNESCO heritage sites can no longer be destroyed by events.
⚙️Audio latency increased for older CPUs.
⚙️Localization update.
⚙️Dozens of smaller changes that did not make it on this list.
⚙️Museums were not showing their icons when the player was low on cash.
⚙️Gold bars are now showing in the trade dialogue again.
⚙️City growth and immigration rates increased further.
⚙️Missing icon restored for deregulating taxis.
⚙️Fixed an edge-case where the endgame would not trigger if specific conditions were in place.


We appreciate how involved the community has gotten, keep it coming over on the Modern Wolf DIscord and here on the Steam forums: we read absolutely everything and, as you can see, we're putting your feedback into action.

💞Thank you very much for playing Rogue State Revolution. Stay tuned here on Steam, on Discord, and on the Modern Wolf Twitter for more details on the next updates soon.💞

notes.title: Update 1.0b is live!
notes.notes:
We promised you that the 1.0b update would land tomorrow, but after testing we thought it didn't make sense to make the players wait another day. So here it is, Update 1.0b, live on the default branch, featuring the following bug fixes and improvements:


Fixes to the "Green Economy" policy due to a bug involving negative Minister favors.
Full restoration of the four videos that were removed for compatibility reasons in 1.0a
Laser targets are no longer altered when loading a savegame in the meteor crisis.
Meteor crisis now clears from objectives tracker when complete.
Many bugfixes for the trade agreement UI, including disappearing demand icons.
Bugfix where the endgame was started prematurely.
Bugfix where movement range displays were inaccurate under certain edge cases.
Bugfix where inaccurate revenue/import numbers were showing in the production tooltips.
Bugfix where gifted troops were not triggering quest completion under certain conditions.
Minister Addad will no longer die when he's running against you in an election.  (After the election... good luck, Minister.)
Minister quests will no longer promise loyalty less than 0% on failure.
Loading a game no longer resets your relationship with major influencing powers.
Update to the commodity pricing graph.
All units can be "parked" so they aren't considered unmoved.
Baseline reduction in the corruption rate of buildings.
Policies that will further reduce the corruption rate of buildings.
Multiple localization fixes (thanks Alex [GER])
Faster camera-scrolling with the shift key.
Various pathfinding adjustments.

Update 1.0c with a few more fixes is already in the works, and so is a much meater 1.1 update. That forthcoming 1.1 update will include a brand-new interface which will allow you to renegotiate trade agreements, all-new surveyor mechanics to keep surveyors useful longer (and potentially allow Basenji to become fully self-sufficient) and more. 

Please do keep the feedback coming on the Modern Wolf DIscord and here on the Steam forums: we read absolutely everything and, as you can see, we're putting your feedback into action.

Thank you very much for playing Rogue State Revolution. Stay tuned here on Steam, on Discord, and on the Modern Wolf Twitter for more details on the next updates soon.

notes.notes:
Greetings from Basenji's Ministry of Software Reform!

As we said yesterday, the 1.0b update is now available on the beta branch for those who would like to test it early. It's also packed with more bug fixes and improvements than we promised yesterday! Here's the full run-down:

Fixes to the "Green Economy" policy due to a bug involving negative Minister favors.
Full restoration of the four videos that were removed for compatibility reasons in 1.0a
Laser targets are no longer altered when loading a savegame in the meteor crisis.
Meteor crisis now clears from objectives tracker when complete.
Many bugfixes for the trade agreement UI, including disappearing demand icons.
Bugfix where the endgame was started prematurely.
Bugfix where movement range displays were inaccurate under certain edge cases.
Bugfix where inaccurate revenue/import numbers were showing in the production tooltips.
Bugfix where gifted troops were not triggering quest completion under certain conditions.
Minister Addad will no longer die when he's running against you in an election.  (After the election... good luck, Minister.)
Minister quests will no longer promise loyalty less than 0% on failure.
Loading a game no longer resets your relationship with major influencing powers.
Update to the commodity pricing graph.
All units can be "parked" so they aren't considered unmoved.
Baseline reduction in the corruption rate of buildings.

To access the beta branch, right-click Rogue State Revolution in your Steam library, select "Properties", then "Betas", and then select the Beta Test Branch from the drop-down menu.

We couldn't have caught some of these issues without the feedback and bug reports you've been sending our way, so please keep it coming! Join the Modern Wolf Discord or email us at beautifulbasenji@modernwolf.net.

If all goes well with testing today, you can expect to see this update live for everyone on the default game branch this Monday, 22nd of March. We'll let you know tomorrow here on Steam, on Discord, and on the Modern Wolf Twitter when this update is live.

Thanks so much for playing Rogue State Revolution! More soon.
